description: Slide deck themes for the AI Slides applet (mChatAI+). Each theme is a token set: colors, font designs, corner radius. The Swift renderer owns all geometry; adding a theme here ships with zero rebuild. Optional tokens: `palette` (categorical chart colours, fixed order — validate with the dataviz palette validator), `gradient` {from,to,angle}, `backgroundImage` (a file under this folder), `footer` {slideNumbers}.
